signature.name: VTask.eqLocus
signature.type: {R : Type u} -> {S : Type v} -> [NonUnitalNonAssocRing R] -> [NonUnitalNonAssocRing S] -> (f g : R →ₙ+* S) -> NonUnitalSubring R

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The equalizer locus is a total construction with no junk-value conventions; it is well-defined for every pair of non-unital ring homomorphisms f and g, including degenerate cases such as f = g or f and g agreeing only at 0.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {S : Type*} [inst1 : NonUnitalNonAssocRing R] [inst2 : NonUnitalNonAssocRing S] (f g : R →ₙ+* S), (∀ x : R, f x = g x) → VTask.eqLocus f g = ⊤
